GREETINGS: 
 
WE COMMAND YOU, that all business and excuses being laid aside, you appear before the 
attorneys for the Plaintiff, STOLZENBERG CORTELLI, LLP, on December 8, 2025, at 
10:00 a.m., for an Examination Before Trial to be conducted virtually (a meeting link will 
be provided). 
 
TAKE NOTICE that failure to comply with this subpoena is punishable as a contempt of 
Court and shall render you liable to the person on whose behalf this subpoena was issued for 
a penalty not exceeding fifty dollars ($50.00) and all damages sustained by reason of your 
failure to comply. 
 
This subpoena is issued by the attorney of record for the Plaintiff pursuant to CPLR §§ 2301 
– 2308 and 3106(b), and no prior order of the Court is required.
